name: BRACHYGLOTTIS REPENS
key_symptoms: Cramp in fingers, thumb, and wrist when writing-soreness extending along flexor carpi ulnaris.
guiding_symptoms: Cramp in fingers, thumb, and wrist when writing-soreness extending along flexor carpi ulnaris.
gi_symptoms: Feeling as if something rolling about. Fluttering in region of ovary.
urinary_symptoms: Pressure in neck of bladder; urging to urinate. Sense of swashing in bladder. Soreness in urethra; feeling as if urine could not be retained. Urine contains mucous corpuscles and epithelium, albumen and casts.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Cramp in fingers, thumb, and wrist when writing-soreness extending along flexor carpi ulnaris.

source.title: BRACHYGLOTTIS REPENS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
